issues: 每个元素落地都放一团 multiply 琥珀色径向光，在奶白纸面上读作一块块脏污渍，而且 9 个元素逐个发光（Q4 群发）
飞行拖影是滞后 8% 的单层模糊副本，读作重影而不是速度
字标 148px 横跨画面，左右两张卡片的文字直接压在 "AI" 和 "Lab" 下面，信息打架
金尘是 2–3px、最高 0.35 透明度的小点，在亮场上几乎看不见；缓推在 f40 从静止直接以匀速起步
副标题 TEAM RESEARCH CONSOLE 只有 25px（<3% 帧高）；结尾淡到透明，末帧是一张半灰的脏画面
changes: 去掉逐个落地光斑，改为落地压实：过冲回落 cue+9→16f 内接触影收紧、元素 1.5% 轻压，靠运动本身表达到位
飞行段改用按屏幕速度计算的方向性运动模糊（SpeedBlur，0.3×px/帧、封顶 22），落地自动归零
左右两张卡片上移到 y≈300/318，给字标留出干净的横带；字标加 letterpress 下沿纸面高光 + 极软环境影，舞台光余量 0.25→0.32
金尘 2.4–4.2px 带暖光晕、0.35–0.7 透明度并微闪，另加 6 颗前景失焦光斑做景深；缓推改为 36f 起 in-out 零速起步，接 crane 不突变
副标题提到 32px 并带 6px 上移落座；收尾显式淡到暖墨色 #0f0d0a（ease-in，末帧恰好全暗），全片叠极弱颗粒
issuesEn: Every element landed with a multiply amber radial glow that read as dirty stains on the cream paper, and all 9 elements flashed one by one (a Q4 mass-glow violation)
The flight trail was a single blurred copy lagging 8%, reading as a double image rather than speed
The 148px wordmark spanned the frame and the side cards' text sat directly under "AI" and "Lab", so the two fought
Gold dust was 2–3px dots at most 0.35 opacity, almost invisible on the bright field; the slow push started at constant speed from rest at f40
The TEAM RESEARCH CONSOLE subtitle was only 25px (<3% of frame height); the ending faded to transparent, leaving a murky half-grey last frame
changesEn: Removed the per-element landing glow in favour of a landing settle: over cue+9→16f the contact shadow tightens and the element squashes 1.5%, so arrival is told by motion alone
Flight now uses speed-driven directional motion blur (SpeedBlur, 0.3×px/frame, capped at 22) that drops to zero on landing

The two side cards moved up to y≈300/318 to leave a clean band for the wordmark; the wordmark gets a letterpress paper highlight plus a very soft ambient shadow, and the stage-light hold rises 0.25→0.32

Gold dust is now 2.4–4.2px with a warm halo at 0.35–0.7 opacity and a gentle twinkle, plus 6 defocused foreground bokeh for depth; the push eases in from rest at 36f so it hands off from the crane without a kink
Subtitle raised to 32px with a 6px settle; the ending fades explicitly to warm ink #0f0d0a (ease-in, fully dark on the last frame), with faint grain over the whole shot
